candidates.name: Kettlebell Farmers Carry
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Farmers Carry
Beginner
1
Hold two kettlebells in each hand.
2
Keep your shoulders blades pulled back and walk for a specified duration.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Wrist Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Wrist Curl
Novice
1
Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing outwards.
2
Flex your wrist towards your body until the kettlebell is level with your stomach.
3
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Wrist Extension
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Wrist Extension
Novice
1
Stand up straight with a kettlebell in both hands in front of your pelvis, with your forearms facing inwards.
2
Flex your wrist upwards until wrists are fully extended.
3
Lower to the starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Row (Single)
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Row (Single)
Beginner
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart holding the kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
2
Bend forward at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knees, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Row
Novice
1
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, shifting one foot behind you. Hold the kettlebell in the same hand as the leg shifted backwards.
2
Bend forwards at the hips bringing the kettlebell to the floor while you slightly bend your knee, keeping your back straight.
3
Lift the kettlebell upwards towards your chest and lower - repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Reverse Curl
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
2
Hold kettlebell with palms facing down.
3
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Bench Wrist Curl
Novice
1
Grip the kettlebells with your palm facing upwards with your forearm rested against the bench.
2
Slowly curl your wrist upwards in a semicircular motion.
3
Return to starting position and repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Farmers March
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Farmers March
Intermediate
1
Stand tall holding two kettlebells in each hand.
2
March in place for the desired amount of reps or time.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers March
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers March
Beginner
1
Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, lift the knee of one leg off the floor to knee height.
2
Bring the leg back to standing and repeat with the other leg, keeping the kettlebell on the same side.
3
Repeat.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Curl
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Reverse Curl
Beginner
1
Stand with feet hip-width apart.
2
Hold a kettlebell with palms facing down.
3
Lift kettlebell toward shoulders, squeezing biceps, then lower with control.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Walking Farmers March
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Walking Farmers March
Beginner
1
Standing straight with kettlebells, start walking towards a set point. Pulling your knee up toward the ceiling.
2
Make sure to keep your chest tall and shoulder blades pulled back.
3
Try to keep your stride distance roughly the same.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Alternating Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Alternating Row
Beginner
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, kettlebell in one hand.
2
Bend at hips, row kettlebell to chest.
3
Alternate hands for each row.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Row
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Row
Beginner
1
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hold a kettlebell in each hand.
2
Hinge at hips, keep back straight, and pull both kettlebells to hips.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Row On Bench
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Row On Bench
Novice
1
Start by standing in front of a flat bench with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a kettlebell in one hand.
2
Place your other hand on the bench for support, and bend at the waist so that your chest is parallel to the ground.
3
From this starting position, row the kettlebell up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blade together as you do so.
4
Make sure to keep your elbow close to your body and your core engaged throughout the movement.

candidates.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers Walk
candidates.cardText:
Kettlebell Single Arm Farmers Walk
Novice
1
Standing straight with a kettlebell in one hand, walk for a specified distance or duration.
2
Stay upright and don't lean to one side.
